definitions.explanation: A student in their second year of a given school level. As with {一年生|いちねんせい}, the school type is given or understood from context (elementary, junior high, high school, or university).

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{今|いま}{二年生|にねんせい}だ。
examples.english: My daughter is in second grade now.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}{二年生|にねんせい}から{専門|せんもん}{科目|かもく}が{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: From sophomore year of university, specialized subjects increase.

examples.japanese: {中学|ちゅうがく}{二年生|にねんせい}になると、{部活動|ぶかつどう}で{後輩|こうはい}を{指導|しどう}する{立場|たちば}になる。
examples.english: When you become a second-year junior-high student, you take on the role of guiding underclassmen in club activities.

notes:
Compound of {二年|にねん} (two years) + {生|せい} (student). The school type is normally specified ({小学|しょうがく}{二年生|にねんせい}, {中学|ちゅうがく}{二年生|にねんせい}, etc.) or clear from context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小学|しょうがく}{二年生|にねんせい}: second-grader (elementary)
- {中学|ちゅうがく}{二年生|にねんせい}: second-year junior high student
- {高校|こうこう}{二年生|にねんせい}: second-year high school student
- {大学|だいがく}{二年生|にねんせい}: university sophomore

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一年生|いちねんせい}: first-year student
- {三年生|さんねんせい}: third-year student
- {中|ちゅう}{二|に}: 'middle-school second-year' (very common abbreviation; also slang for awkward teenage behavior)
